αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἴης: αἶα — land, earth; gen. sg., epic by-form of γαῖα
αὐτή: αὐτός — self; fem. nom. sg., intensive, stressing the subject herself: ’(you) yourself’
αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also intensive in agreement with an unexpressed ’we’: ’we ourselves’ (αὐτοὶ βῆμεν ’we ourselves stepped out’)
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg.: ’she herself’, ’you yourself’ · also fem. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὴ δὲ χθαμαλὴ κεῖται ’and the island itself lies low’)
αὐτὴν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also intensive, accusative subject of an infinitive: ’she herself’ (αὐτὴν ποθέσαι ’that she herself miss [him]’) · also attributive, ’the same’: τῷ αὐτὴν ὁδὸν ’the very same road’ · also intensive with a noun, ’very’: εἰς ὁδὸν αὐτὴν ’into the very path’
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’)
αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said) · also intensive with a noun: ’of the heroes themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἡρώων) · also with the article, ’the same’: τοκήων τῶν αὐτῶν ’the very same parents’ · also masc./neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, ’their’ (αὐτῶν τε φθογγήν ’their voice’, of the creatures on the far shore) · also gen. pl. ’our own’, possessive of the speaker’s group, with no other possessive (αὐτῶν … ἀφραδίῃσιν ’through our own follies’) · also masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of them’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῶν ’not one of them’)
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βάλεν: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, in tmesis with ἀμφί: ’threw about’ · also in tmesis with ἐπί (βάλεν δ’ ἐπὶ ... ἑκάστῳ = ἐπέβαλε): ’threw over, cast upon’ · also in tmesis with παρά (πάρ … βάλεν = παρέβαλε): ’threw beside, set before’
βεβήκει: βαίνω — go, walk, step; plpf. 3 sg. with simple past force (Homeric pluperfect): ’had gone, went’
βοῦς: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; acc. pl. · also masc./fem. nom. sg. (same spelling as the acc. pl.): ’the ox, the heifer’ (ἦλθε ... βοῦς ’the heifer came’)
βρώμης: βρῶμη — food, eating; fem. gen. sg.
βῆν: βαίνω — go, step; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβην)
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γόον: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. acc. sg.
δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear; neut. acc. sg., used collectively: ’tears’ · also elided δάκρυ’ = δάκρυα, neut. acc. pl. · also literal sg. with an attributive adjective, not collective: θαλερὸν δάκρυ ’a swelling tear’
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δαινυμένους: δαίνυμι — give a feast; mid. δαίνυμαι, feast, banquet; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl.: ’feasting’
δαινύμενοι: δαίνυμι — feast; mid. pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’feasting’
δειδίμεν: δείδω — fear, dread; perf. inf. with pres. sense, epic (δειδίμεν = Attic δεδιέναι): ’to fear’
δι: διά — through; prep. + acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through (the night)’
διοτρεφές: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured (epithet of kings); adj., masc. voc. sg.
δόλον: δόλος — trick, snare, cunning device; masc. acc. sg.
δώμασι: δῶμα — house, home; neut. dat. pl.
δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖα: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. nom. sg., epithet of goddesses and heroes
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb: ’the house’
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο)
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’
εἰσοράασθαι: εἰσοράω — look upon, behold; pres. inf. mid., uncontracted, diectasis (= Attic εἰσορᾶσθαι)
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’)
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; impersonal + inf.: ’it might be possible for him’
εὐρύλοχος: Εὐρύλοχος — Eurylochus, a companion of Odysseus; masc. nom. sg.
εὗρον: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ηὗρον)
θέσφατόν: θέσφατος — declared/decreed by a god, fated; adj., neut. nom. sg. (θέσφατόν ἐστι ’it is fated, god-decreed’)
θαλερὸν: θαλερός — blooming, vigorous, swelling; adj., neut. acc. sg. (θαλερὸν δάκρυ ’a swelling tear’) · also masc. acc. sg. (θαλερὸν γάμον ’a flourishing marriage’)
θεάων: θεά — goddess; gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic θεῶν)
θοὴν: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. sg.
θοῇ: θοός — swift, quick (standing epithet of ships); fem. dat. sg.
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θῖνα: θίς — shore, beach; fem. acc. sg.
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
κίρκη: Κίρκη — Circe, the enchantress goddess; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., address: ’Circe!’ (ὦ Κίρκη)
κίρκης: Κίρκη — Circe, the enchantress goddess; fem. gen. sg.
κακῶν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. pl.: ’of ills, of misfortunes’
καρτερὸν: καρτερός — strong, mighty, staunch; masc. acc. sg. (καρτερὸν ὅρκον ’a mighty oath’)
κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’)
κατάλεξον: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order (not yet ’choose’, as later); aor. imper. 2 sg.
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’)
κελεύεις: κελεύω — bid, command, order; pres. 2 sg.
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’
κλαῖον: κλαίω — weep, wail; impf. 1 sg. · also impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔκλαιον): ’they wept’
κοίλῃ: κοῖλος — hollow; fem. dat. sg., standing epithet of ships
κρέα: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic κρέα contr.)
κτήματα: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. nom./acc. pl.
λίπ: λίπα — richly, thickly; adv. (perh. instead an elided case-form of a noun ’fat’, cf. λίπος), elided (λίπ’ = λίπα) · also λείπω — leave; aor. imper. 2 sg., elided (λίπ’ = λίπε): ’leave (me)’
λαερτιάδη: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes, patronymic of Odysseus; voc. sg.
λοῦσέν: λούω — bathe, wash; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, accented before an enclitic (λοῦσέν τε)
λῦσον: λύω — loosen, release, set free; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’release!’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγαρον: μέγαρον — hall, main room of the house; acc. sg.
μέθυ: μέθυ — wine; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg. (identical form), subject of a passive verb (μέθυ πίνετο ’wine was drunk’)
μένειν: μένω — stay, remain, wait; pres. inf. act.
μακρὰ: μακρός — long, tall, high; neut. nom./acc. pl. (δούρατα μακρὰ ’long timbers’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’with long (steps)’ (μακρὰ βιβάς ’striding with long steps’)
μεγάροιο: μέγαρον — hall; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house
μειλιχίοις: μειλίχιος — gentle, soothing; masc. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσιν
μελέων: μέλος — limb; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic μελῶν): ’of the limbs’
μερμήριξα: μερμηρίζω — ponder, be torn in mind; aor. 1 sg.
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’) · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also adverb, ’among them, in their midst’: μετὰ δὲ πρέπει ἀγρομένοισιν ’and he stands out among the gathered’
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’
μηκέτι: μηκέτι — no longer, not any more; neg. adv., used with subj./imper. in prohibitions
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νεώτεροι: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος, masc. nom. pl.: ’younger’
νηί: ναῦς (epic νηῦς) — ship; fem. dat. sg. νηί
νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’)
οἴκτρ: οἰκτρός — pitiable, piteous; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (οἴκτρ’ = οἰκτρά): ’piteously’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household (and its stores); acc. sg.
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; neut. as exclamatory adv.: ’how!, what a thing!’ (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also causal conj. after a verb of emotion, ’in that, that’
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ)
οὔλας: οὖλος — thick, woolly, curly; fem. acc. pl.
οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
πάμπρωτον: πάμπρωτος — first of all, very first; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first of all’
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’)
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’)
πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. sg.
πίθοντο: πείθομαι — obey, be persuaded, + dat.; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπίθοντο)
πίνοντας: πίνω — drink; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’as they were drinking’
παρισταμένη: παρίσταμαι — stand beside, come to one’s side; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
πατρίδ: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; fem. acc. sg., elided (πατρίδ’ = πατρίδα)
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
πατρίδος: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; gen. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’)
ποθ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided before a rough breathing (ποθ’ = ποτέ)
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες)
πολυμήχαν: πολυμήχανος — many-devising; voc. sg., elided (πολυμήχαν’ = πολυμήχανε)
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’
ποτῆτος: ποτής — drink, drinking; fem. gen. sg.
προσέειπον: προσεῖπον (aor. of πρόσφημι) — speak to, address; aor. 1 sg.
προσέφην: προσφημί — speak to, address; aor. 1 sg. (προσέφην, aor. of φημί): ’I addressed’
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προσηύδων: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 1 sg. (καί μιν ... προσηύδων ’I addressed him’)
πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’)
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (same form): τοῦτο πόρε ’give this!’
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress (title of respect for a goddess); fem. nom. sg. · also of a mortal woman, a respectful title: ’revered, honoured’ (πότνια μήτηρ ’the honoured mother’)
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv. · also a preposition + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ Νέστορα) · also preverb in tmesis (πὰρ … θῆκεν = παρέθηκε ’set before’) · also a preposition + dat., ’beside’ (πὰρ πυρί ’beside the fire’)
πᾶσαι: πᾶς — all, every; fem. nom. pl.
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
σίτῳ: σῖτος — grain, food; masc. dat. sg.
σηκοὶ: σηκός — pen, fold; masc. nom. pl.
σμερδαλέον: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’terribly’
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
σπήεσσι: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic σπέσι)
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στᾶσα: ἵστημι — stand, set; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (root aor. ἔστην): ’having stood, standing’
σφίσι: σφεῖς — they; dat. pl., epic σφίσι, often reflexive: ’to/for themselves’
σφεας: σφεῖς — they; epic acc. pl. pron.: ’them’
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σχεδόν: σχεδόν — near, close at hand; adv.
σὴν: σός — your, yours; fem. acc. sg.
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also adverb ’along, with (us)’ construed with ἔχοντες, which takes the object (σὺν … χεῖρας ἔχοντες ’having hands along with us’)
σῦς: σῦς — swine, pig, boar; masc./fem. nom. sg. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (= σύας), object: ’swine’
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελεσφόρον: τελεσφόρος — bringing to completion, full (of a year’s cycle); masc. acc. sg.
τινά: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., indefinite, accented before enclitic οἱ (with ὅν: ὅν τινα ’whatever’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’any’, with an understood noun (εἴ τινά που δεδάηκας ’if you have learned any’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τούτου: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. gen. sg.
τούτων: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this, that; gen. pl.: ’of these’
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’; may anticipate a following clause: ’this (namely that…)’
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ἕως ’until’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’)
φάρμακον: φάρμακον — drug, potion (healing or deadly); acc. sg.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
χέρσου: χέρσος — dry land, shore; fem. gen. sg., with ἐπί: ’on the shore’
χλαίνας: χλαῖνα — a thick cloak, mantle; fem. acc. pl.
χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, it is right; impersonal verb + acc. and inf. · also + acc. of the person and gen. of the thing: ’there is need of’
ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.
ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀνάγκῃ: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’under compulsion’
ἀνήιον: ἄνειμι — go up; impf. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνῄειν): ’I went up’
ἀτασθαλίῃσιν: ἀτασθαλίη — wanton folly, reckless wrongdoing; fem. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -αις)
ἁδινὸν: ἁδινός — thick, close-packed, crowded; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, of weeping: ’in a thick flood, heavily’
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ (ἐπεὶ ἂρ δή ’since, as it seems’)
ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄγετ: ἄγω — lead; pl. imper. ’come now!’, elided (ἄγετ’ = ἄγετε), addressed to a group
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄλλοθεν: ἄλλοθεν — from elsewhere, from another place; adv. (ἄλλος + -θεν ’from’)
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄορ: ἄορ — sword (poetic, = ξίφος); neut. acc. sg.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄσπετα: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, untold, unutterable; neut. nom. pl.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅπαντας: ἅπας — all, the whole, every; masc. acc. pl.
ἐάσομεν: ἐάω — let, allow; leave off, give up; fut. 1 pl., used hortatively: ’let us leave off’
ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, happen; aor. 3 pl.: ’became, were’ (ὁμηγερέες ἐγένοντο ’were assembled together’)
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλέαιρε: ἐλεαίρω (epic by-form of ἐλεέω) — pity; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’pity!’
ἐλαίῳ: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. dat. sg.
ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented (non-enclitic emphatic): ’to me’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐμοῖς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. pl.
ἐμὴν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναίσιμος: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, right, according to due measure; masc./fem. nom. sg. (built on αἶσα ’due share’)
ἐναντίαι: ἐναντίος — facing, opposite (+ dat.); fem. nom. pl.
ἐνιαυτὸν: ἐνιαυτός — year; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a year’
ἐνόησεν: νοέω — perceive, devise, think of; aor. 3 sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
ἐπεπείθετο: πείθω — persuade; plpf. 3 sg. with impf. sense: ’was won over’
ἐπηετανὸν: ἐπηετανός — continuous, unfailing, year-long; neut. acc. sg.
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν); conj. + subj. · also + opt. in a generalizing conditional clause, without a further ἄν/κε: ἐπὴν κρητῆρι μιγείη ’when it has been mixed’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’)
ἐρήτυον: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; impf. 3 pl.: ’were holding back’
ἐρίηρας: ἐρίηρος — traditionally ’trusty’, exact sense uncertain (of companions); masc. acc. pl.
ἐρίηρες: ἐρίηρος — trusty, dear (of companions; exact sense uncertain); masc. nom. pl.
ἐρχομένη: ἔρχομαι — come, go; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
ἐρύσσομεν: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic doubled-σ, short vowel, hortatory: ’let us drag’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐφάμην: φημί — say, speak; impf. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I was speaking, I spoke’
ἐφεύρομεν: ἐφευρίσκω — find, discover, catch (in the act); aor. 1 pl.
ἐὺ: ἐΰ — well (Attic εὖ, printed without a diaeresis); adv.
ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
ἑτάρους: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); acc. pl.
ἑτάρων: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. gen. pl. (= Attic ἑταίρων)
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔδων: ἔδω — eat (= ἐσθίω); pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic: ’eating’
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔλασεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤλασεν)
ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic, shortened (= Attic εἶναι; cf. ἔμμεναι)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔρυσθαι: ἔρυμαι — guard, protect, shelter; epic inf.
ἔρχεο: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχου)
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφαν: φημί — say; impf./aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔφασαν): ’they said’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔφυν: φύω — grow; intransitive root aor. 3 pl. (a poetic 3 pl. in -ν, identical to the 1 sg.): ’they had grown’
ἔχοντα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ‘holding’
ἔχουσ: ἔχω — have, hold, inhabit; pres. 3 pl., elided (ἔχουσ’ = ἔχουσι) · or fem. nom. pl. part. ἔχουσαι
ἔχυντο: χέω — pour; mid. stream, be spread; aor. 3 pl. mid., root aorist, epic (= Attic ἐχύθησαν): ’streamed around’
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕπεσθαι: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany, go with; pres. inf.: ’to go with, accompany’
ἕταροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl., epic by-form ἕταροι (= ἑταῖροι)
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ)
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’
ἡγεμόνευ: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, lead; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἡγεμόνευ’ = ἡγεμόνευε)
ἡδύ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; neut. acc. sg., attributive
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
ἤπειρόνδε: ἤπειρος — mainland; fem. acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ’to the mainland’
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. inf.: ‘to see’
ἰθάκην: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg.
ἱεροῖς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., masc. dat. pl., agreeing with βωμοῖς
ἱερὰ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. ’sacred rites, offerings’
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον) · also aor. 3 pl. (the same ending serves both persons): ’they saw’
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl.; with short ι (by metre) unaugmented; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented (the spelling cannot show it)
ἵν: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj., elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα) · also relative adverb of place, ’where’ (= Attic οὗ): τῶν ἐνὶ δήμῳ, ἵν’ οἴχεται ’among those of the land where he has gone’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’
ἶσος: ἴσος — equal, like (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg., epic ἶσος
ὀίεαι: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose, imagine; pres. 2 sg.: ‘you imagine’
ὀδυρόμενοι: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’lamenting’
ὀδυσεῦ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., single-σ form (Attic Ὀδυσσεῦ)
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
ὄλοντο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be destroyed; aor. 3 pl. mid., no augment
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅπλα: ὅπλον — tool, gear; pl. ship’s tackle and rigging (not weapons here); neut. acc. pl.
ὅσ: ὅσος — as much/many as; relative correlative pron., neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσ’ = ὅσα)
ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’) · also + opt., in a repeated past clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂψ ἄρχοιτο ’whenever he began again’) · also + subj. without ἄν, in a general clause: ὅτ’ … ἔχῃ ’whenever … holds’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ὧραι: ὥρα — season, time of year; fem. nom. pl.
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥάβδον: ῥάβδος — wand, rod, staff; fem. acc. sg. (Hermes’s standing attribute)
